official.deadline_note: Applications run 21 September 2026 to 19 October 2026 at midday through the DIRBDE online form; related steps later in the cycle include the PAES sitting in December 2026, preselection on 4 January 2027 and final selection on 18 January 2027.
official.status_note: The call for Admision 2027 is open from 21 September 2026 and closes 19 October 2026 at midday; the BUCH regulation was renewed by Decreto Universitario No. 0013621 of 20 April 2026.
official.tuition_coverage_note: Financia el valor completo de la matricula y el arancel de cualquier carrera o programa de pregrado de la Universidad de Chile (finances the full enrolment fee and tuition of any undergraduate career or programme at the university).
benefits: Finances the full value of the matricula (enrolment fee) and the arancel (annual tuition) of any undergraduate career or programme of the Universidad de Chile
100 awards per year, aimed at students with academic excellence
Annual renewal for the official duration of the programme while academic-progress and socio-economic re-accreditation conditions are met
eligibility: Be in the fourth year of secondary education (cuarto ano de ensenanza media) in 2026
Have a secondary-school grade average of 6.0 or above
Present the Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares within the 90% socioeconomic band (an Informe Social may be requested where the Cartola is unavailable)
Sit the PAES battery for Admision 2027 (December 2026) and obtain a weighted average of at least 700 points between the obligatory Competencia Lectora and Competencia Matematica M1 tests
Apply for MINEDUC student benefits for Admision 2027
Authorise, through the informed consent in the DEMRE platform, the sharing of PAES results with universities attached to the Sistema de Acceso a la Educacion Superior
Not hold Gratuidad, Beca Vocacion de Profesor or an equivalent benefit from MINEDUC
requirements: Apply through the DIRBDE online form between 21 September and 19 October 2026 at midday
Attach the Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares to the online form
Apply to a Universidad de Chile undergraduate programme through the Sistema de Acceso a la Educacion Superior (SAES)
Be summoned to enrol at a regular Universidad de Chile programme and formalise the matricula within the university's deadlines
Complete the FOCES form and the socio-economic accreditation with the academic unit's social worker for the 2027 academic period
Complete the FUAS for the 2027 academic period (October 2026)
documents: Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares attached to the online application form
Informe Social where requested (may be requested where the Cartola is unavailable)
PAES 2026 results for Admision 2027 (shared by DEMRE/MINEDUC via the informed consent once published)
selection_criteria: Candidates are ranked highest to lowest by the BUCH weighted score from PAES results

Weighting: 25% Competencia Lectora score; 25% best score between Competencia Matematica M1 and M2; 20% best score among the elective Historia y Ciencias Sociales and Ciencias tests; 20% grade ranking score; 10% secondary-school grade average
The 100 highest-ranked eligible candidates are awarded
coverage: Matricula (enrolment fee) for the first year of the programme
Arancel (annual tuition) for any undergraduate career or programme of the Universidad de Chile
Renewed annually for the official duration of the chosen programme
application_method: Complete the DIRBDE online form at https://postulacionbuch.uchile.cl/auth/login and attach the Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares
Sit PAES in December 2026 and await the preselection ranking announced on 4 January 2027 at midday
Apply to a Universidad de Chile programme through SAES, be summoned to enrol and formalise the matricula
Final selection result announced 18 January 2027; complete FOCES and socio-economic accreditation, and the FUAS for 2027
official.application_route: Online form at https://postulacionbuch.uchile.cl/auth/login (21 September to 19 October 2026, midday), with the Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares attached; admission to the university is separate, through SAES
official.citizenship_residency: Directed at Chilean secondary-school students; the Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares within the 90% socioeconomic band is required
official.duration: Full official duration of the chosen undergraduate programme, renewed annually
official.description: The Beca Universidad de Chile (BUCH) is a tuition benefit awarded to 100 young people of academic excellence, financing the full value of the enrolment fee and the tuition of any undergraduate career or programme of the Universidad de Chile. Its objective is to recognise and reward the excellent academic performance and economic support needs of the country's young talents.
official.program_type: University merit and socioeconomic need scholarship

verification.notes: Official Universidad de Chile convocatoria page and the linked Reglamento BUCH (Decreto Universitario No. 0013621 of 20 April 2026) were fetched in full on 2026-10-10; award count, coverage, dates, ranking weights and renewal rules were read directly from that page.

not_confirmed: the monetary value of the award (the page finances the full matricula and arancel of the chosen programme but publishes no figure, and aranceles differ by programme)
an English-language requirement (none is published for this scholarship)

applicant_utility.summary: There are exactly 100 BUCH places, so this is effectively a top-100 ranking race decided by PAES: 25% Competencia Lectora, 25% your better maths paper, 20% your better elective, 20% ranking and 10% your school average. The BUCH application does not admit you to the university - you must separately apply through SAES, be summoned to enrol and formalise the matricula, or the award cannot be finalised. If MINEDUC grants you gratuidad or Beca Vocacion de Profesor instead, the ministerial benefit prevails over BUCH.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving Chilean secondary-school leavers from low and middle socioeconomic households (Registro Social de Hogares up to the 90% band) who have not won MINEDUC gratuidad and want tuition fully covered at the Universidad de Chile.
application_readiness_checklist: File the DIRBDE online form before 19 October 2026 at 12:00 and attach the Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares
Give the informed consent in DEMRE when registering for PAES so results reach the universities; without it your application cannot be ranked
Apply for MINEDUC student benefits for Admision 2027 (FUAS period opened October 2026) - this is a BUCH requirement in itself
Confirm your weighted PAES score across Competencia Lectora and Competencia Matematica M1 reaches at least 700 points
Keep your secondary average at 6.0 or above and plan to reach at least 70% academic progress in the first year for renewal
common_rejection_risks: Ranking below the top 100 eligible candidates on the BUCH weighted PAES score
Being assigned MINEDUC gratuidad or Beca Vocacion de Profesor, which cancels BUCH eligibility
Not applying through SAES or not formalising the matricula after being summoned, which blocks final selection on 18 January 2027
Missing the 12:00 midday cut-off on 19 October 2026 - the form closes at noon, not midnight
Failing to attach the Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares, or falling outside the 90% socioeconomic band
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Living costs, transport, materials and personal expenses in Santiago: BUCH covers only the matricula and arancel of a Universidad de Chile undergraduate programme and pays no stipend.
document_audit: The Cartola del Registro Social de Hogares must be current and attached in the form; an Informe Social can substitute only where the Cartola is unavailable
The DEMRE informed consent is easy to miss at PAES registration and silently blocks the whole application
For renewal you will need FOCES plus a socio-economic accreditation with your academic unit's social worker, then the FUAS for 2027
alerts: Preselection is published 4 January 2027 at midday and final selection 18 January 2027 - plan your SAES enrolment around these dates
Renewal requires at least 70% academic progress in year one and 80% from year two, and you may not exceed the programme's formal duration
The BUCH regulation was replaced in April 2026 (Decreto Universitario No. 0013621), so rely on the 2026-2027 call pages rather than older guidance
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Single online form at postulacionbuch.uchile.cl with the RSH Cartola attached, then PAES in December 2026, preselection 4 January 2027, SAES application and enrolment, final selection 18 January 2027.
